titleZh: 这个周末你打算干什么?
goalZh: 会用 be going to 说自己的计划和打算
canDoZh: 能说出自己这个周末的计划,比如"我周六打算和朋友去爬山"

newItems.noteZh: be 要随人称变:I'm / she's / they're going to…,后面接动词原形;口语常读成 gonna。
Do you have any plans this weekend? 这周末有什么安排?(常用复数 plans)
美国人说"去爬山"多是 go hiking(走山路);climb 是真的攀爬。
美式 -tain 常读得很轻,像 "moun-n";in the mountains 在山里。
l 开头舌尖顶上齿龈;西雅图周围湖很多。
美式常说 stay home(不加 at)。
重音在后 re-LAX;stay home and relax 在家放松一下。
不可数,不加 s:a lot of homework;写作业 do homework。
美式连读像 "a-la-da";可数、不可数都能用:a lot of pictures / a lot of homework。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Hi, Lei! Do you have any plans this weekend?
lines.zh: 嗨,磊!这个周末有什么安排吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes! I'm going to go hiking on Saturday.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Cool! Where are you going to go?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: To the mountains, with Ethan and Marcus.
lines.zh: 去山里,和伊森、马库斯一起。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: There's a beautiful lake. I'm going to take a lot of pictures!
lines.zh: 那儿有一个很美的湖。我要拍好多照片!

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Nice! What are you going to do on Sunday?
lines.zh: 真好!那周日你打算做什么?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I'm going to stay home, relax, and do my homework.
lines.zh: 我打算待在宿舍,放松一下,再写写作业。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I have a lot of homework. What about you?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: I have to work on Saturday.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: On Sunday, I'm going to walk to the lake and take pictures.
lines.zh: 周日我打算走到湖边去,拍拍照。

options: 和伊森、马库斯去山里徒步

grammar.titleZh: be going to + 动词原形:说打算好的事
grammar.bodyZh: 说已经打算好、计划要做的事,用 be going to + 动词原形。be 要随主语变:I'm going to… / He's going to… / We're going to…。问别人的打算:What are you going to do this weekend? 表示将来的时间词一般放在句末:tomorrow、tonight、this weekend、on Saturday、next week。中国学生常见的错:漏掉 be(说成 I going to go hiking);to 后面的动词加了 -ing 或 -s(I'm going to goes)。I'm going to go hiking 里 to 后面的 go 不能省(不说 I'm going to hiking)。发音:口语里 going to 常读成 gonna,听到要认得;自己说完整的 going to 就很好。

examples.text: I'm going to go hiking on Saturday.
What are you going to do this weekend?
examples.zh: 你这个周末打算做什么?

examples.text: Ethan is going to play video games tonight.
We're going to see a movie next week.
examples.zh: 我们打算下周去看电影。
